description:
**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to understand technical requirements as well as performance, scalability, quality, and security concerns.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience in Fullstack development
* Extensive technical experience and development expertise in .Net Core or Java, Web services (REST), Angular or React.
* Experience with cloud offerings AWS
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Docker, Spinnaker etc.
* Good knowledge in HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap and scripting languages like JavaScript, JQuery etc.
* Proficient with OOPS and Design principles. Expertise in writing clean, secure and refactored code.
* Knowledge and hands-on Experience with Test Driven Development. Experience with relational and non-relational Database technologies like SQL, MongoDB. Proficient with Git or any source code management tool.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle. Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:

Alfa Laval is on an active Digital Transformation journey. As part of this, we are building modern, cloud-native applications used by order handlers across our factories globally.
  
  
**About The Job**
We are looking for a
**Senior**
**.NET**
**Developer**
to join a global agile development team working within the SAFe framework. You will collaborate closely with developers, a solution architect, a scrum master, a product owner, and testers to deliver high-quality software solutions across our global business organization.
  
  
Your responsibilities will span the full software development lifecycle including refinement, development, debugging, testing, and system configuration — with a strong focus on clean, maintainable code and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain C# / .NET applications in a microservices architecture
* Build and consume REST APIs and integrate with Azure services
* Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to SOLID principles and design patterns
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps
* Collaborate directly with stakeholders to refine and clarify requirements
* Debug and improve existing systems and configurations

**Technical Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
* Hands-on experience with Azure (App Service, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Azure Functions, ARM/Bicep)
* Experience with Azure DevOps build and release pipelines
* Solid understanding of software design patterns and SOLID principles
* Proficient with Git and branching strategies
* Experience writing unit and integration tests
* Experience with microservices architecture is a plus
* Knowledge of React & TypeScript is a plus

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken)
* Ability to work independently and take initiative
* Comfortable navigating a large, global organizational landscape
* A problem-solving mindset and a positive, collaborative attitude

**What's in It for You?**
We offer a challenging position in an open, inclusive environment where we invest in your growth.
  
  
At Alfa Laval, our greatest asset is our people. We encourage lifelong learning, provide the tools to advance your career, and support your well-being through a flexible and sustainable work environment.
  
  
Your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on Alfa Laval's digital transformation and on the experience of customers worldwide.
  
  
Join a global team of specialists — together, we can do more.

ASP.NET Zero

* Knowledge of frontend integration, responsive UI development, and client-side form validation using Angular and TypeScript.

title: Full-Stack Engineer — Systems Conductor
description:
About Bold Business

Bold Business is an AI-first, delivery-first company building production-grade enterprise software, automation engines, and autonomous agent infrastructure. We build the way modern teams build: our engineers are not syntax-typists but Systems Conductors, who leverage advanced AI-agent developer environments to design, build, test, and ship production software at multiples of traditional manual velocity.

The Role

We're hiring
****Full-Stack Systems Conductors****

to own feature delivery across our flagship TechForce platform — spanning React/TypeScript frontends, Python/FastAPI backends, and robust PostgreSQL data schemas.

You'll own high-impact modules from day one, but your true value lies in your ability to design robust databases, orchestrate complex systems, and lead background coding agents through rigorous, test-driven implementations.

****Two principles define how we work, and we hire for both explicitly:****

****AI-Agentic Command.****

AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code CLI, OpenClaw / Hermes Agents / Grokbot / other personal agent harnesses, and custom Model Context Protocol servers) are our native workspace, not a novelty. We expect you to command agents to write boilerplate, scaffold routes, and draft test suites. You provide the system architecture, the security guardrails, and the rigorous critical review. Speed from agents, judgment from you.

****Collaborative by Default.****

Every change is strictly peer-reviewed through pull requests. Documentation and automated unit tests ship in the same PR as the code. Blockers get raised early, not discovered at review. We value highly legible, standardized architectures that outlive their author's immediate attention — brilliant work that only its author understands is a liability here, not an asset.

What You'll Do

* ****Architect schema-first features:****

  design strict API boundaries, typed contracts, and database schemas first, providing the structure background AI agents need to implement features safely
* ****Build and secure module workflows:****

  own recruiter and admin interfaces (screens, tables, profiles, forms, filters, dashboards), REST endpoints, and PostgreSQL relational workflows — with business security and authorization policies strictly enforced at the data layer
* ****Establish codebase context:****

  build and use MCP servers and AST-based dependency graphs to give developer agents standardized, structured access to our repositories
* ****Orchestrate quality loops:****

  set up local testing environments and containerized CI/CD checks where background agents automatically execute test runs, linting, and type validation before any merge
* ****Engage directly with stakeholders:****

  sit with non-technical stakeholders to translate messy operational processes into clean, executable technical requirements — and keep them in the loop as the work progresses
* ****Stabilize and maintain the platform:****

  production defects, small-to-medium gaps, and reporting migration support as Power BI is retired
* ****Review and be reviewed:****

  give and receive pull-request review as a normal working rhythm, with test evidence on every ticket

Non-Negotiables

We'll ask you to demonstrate all of the following — come ready with real examples:

1. ****Active agentic developer loop.****

   You've transitioned beyond copy-pasting code blocks from a browser window. You can walk us through your CLI-native agentic loop: how you coordinate agents, what parameters and guardrails you set, and — specifically — a time you caught and patched an LLM hallucination before it shipped. "I've tried Copilot" is not this.
2. ****Collaboration you can prove.****

   A working history of PR reviews given and received, documentation you wrote that someone else actually used, and a time you escalated a blocker early instead of grinding on it alone. We will check for this specifically.
3. ****Full-stack competency, production-grade.****

   Strong React/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI experience on real systems in real use — not tutorials or side scripts.
4. ****Database schema and security mastery.****

   Highly fluent in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, transactional isolation. You understand why hiding a button in React is not an authorization control; authorization is enforced in the data layer.
5. ****Clean systems architecture.****

   You build robust, decoupled state machines (FastAPI, React state, background queues) that gracefully isolate, log, and recover from real-world API and network failures.
6. ****Enterprise systems awareness.****

   You've designed, maintained, or operated within ERP-class platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or comparable) — or can clearly demonstrate how they work and why they matter: integrated data, standardized process, and a single operational source of truth. You'll help build a platform that plays exactly this role, so you need to understand what it replaces and what it must not break.
7. ****True Agile and continuous improvement.****

   Not standup theater — iterative delivery, working software shipped in small increments, retrospectives that actually change how the team works. Come ready to describe a real process improvement you drove based on what a sprint or a failure taught you.
8. ****End-to-end micro-project ownership.****

   You'll run micro-projects through their full lifecycle: planning and requirements gathering with stakeholders, implementation, testing, and maintenance afterward — documenting your work and processes clearly enough that another team member can be trained to support and back up what you built without you in the room. Come ready to walk us through one project you carried from first conversation to steady-state maintenance.
9. ****Strong English communication, written and spoken.****

   You'll operate in a U.S.-based team environment and explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on experience with OpenClaw, Hermes Agents, or Grokbot agent platforms
* Familiarity with LangGraph or stateful multi-agent orchestration
* Operations-heavy SaaS experience (recruiting, workforce management, ATS, or CRM)
* Multi-tenant application experience
* AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, cloud logs)
* Data imports, deduplication, search/filter interfaces, operational reporting
* Experience joining a codebase mid-flight and getting productive fast

What This Role Is

* A hands-on builder-conductor role with defined module ownership
* AI-accelerated delivery with human judgment on every merge
* A high-performing team operating model: review, documentation, and early communication are the job, not overhead

What This Role Is Not

* Not a solo-operator role — if your best work happens when nobody sees it until it's done, this will be a bad fit
* Not an ML research role
* Not a role where AI tools are optional

Compensation & Logistics

****Compensation based on experience.****

Standard options package per company policy.

****Target start:****

Immediately

Final Note

We will go deep into your past work — what you built, why you built it that way, what broke, and who else could run it after you. The engineers who thrive here are the ones whose systems outlive their attention: documented, reviewed, and understood by the team.

****Bold Business — AI-First. Delivery-First. Team-First.****

title: AI Engineer
description:
We’re seeking a AI Engineer to design and ship production-grade agentic AI systems that automate complex workflows end-to-end. This is a hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You’ll work closely with the Chief Architect, product, engineering, and domain experts to translate ambiguous, high-impact problems into reliable AI-driven user experiences.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Ship AI capabilities that measurably improve user outcomes (quality, time saved, throughput)
  
  
Build systems that are reliable by design: evals, observability, safety, and cost/latency controls from day one
  
  
Iterate quickly using a tight loop of instrument → evaluate → improve → deploy
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Agentic AI Feature & Workflow Development**
  
  

* Build and integrate AI-driven features using LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini on Vertex AI)
* Design and implement tool-using agents (structured function calling, schema validation, retries, fallbacks)
* Build multi-agent workflows when appropriate (e.g., planner/worker, reviewer/critic, specialist routing) and know when a simpler architecture is better
* Create agentic workflows such as document understanding, extraction, reasoning over evidence, task automation, and multi-step decision support
* Own context engineering end-to-end:

+ dynamic context assembly (retrieval + state + tool outputs)
+ context budgeting and compression/summarization
+ grounding strategies to reduce hallucinations and improve consistency

* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search workflows using off-the-shelf vector stores and embedding services

**Evaluation, Quality & Iteration (Core)**

* Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, reliability, and output quality
* Build task-specific eval suites: golden datasets, adversarial cases, regression tests, and rubric-based scoring
* Set up automated evaluation pipelines and release gates (CI/CD-friendly) tied to prompt/model/version changes
* Define and monitor online metrics (e.g., task success rate, human override rate, safety flags, latency, cost) and run experiments/A-B tests where appropriate
* Use LLM-as-judge responsibly: calibrate, validate, and pair with human labels when needed

**Engineering, Integration & Observability**

* Develop scalable backend services and APIs that incorporate AI functionality
* Integrate AI pipelines into existing cloud, microservices, and event-driven architectures
* Implement observability and analytics for all AI features (tracing, evaluations, prompt versioning, cost tracking) Example tooling: Langfuse (and/or OpenTelemetry-compatible stacks)
* Ensure reliability, uptime, performance, and security of AI services
* Build internal tooling for evaluation, testing, prompt/version management, and safe deployment

**Product & Collaboration**

* Partner with product managers, designers, the Chief Architect, and domain SMEs to shape AI-first solutions
* Rapidly prototype concepts and iterate based on user feedback and measurable eval results
* Translate business problems into well-structured AI workflows without requiring ML model training
* Document system behavior, known failure modes, and operational playbooks

**Governance & Safety**

* Implement guardrails, checks, and fallback logic for safe and predictable AI behavior
* Help define and follow compliance, privacy, and responsible AI guidelines
* Design for safe tool execution (bounded actions, permissions, escalation paths, human-in the-loop review

**What You Bring**
**Core Strengths (Required)**

* Strong software engineering background (Python preferred) and experience shipping backend services
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic LLM systems from first principles: agent loops, tool interfaces, planning/replanning, memory/state, and failure handling
* Strong context engineering ability: retrieval strategies, routing, grounding, context budgeting, and long-context tradeoffs
* Strong evaluation discipline: golden datasets, regression gating, automated eval pipelines, and online monitoring
* Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) and AI orchestration frameworks
* Excellent debugging, systems thinking, and problem decomposition skills
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership

**Signals We Value**
  
  

* You’ve shipped an LLM/agent system in production and can clearly explain:

+ the failure modes you discovered
+ the evals you built to catch regressions
+ how you improved cost/latency while increasing quality
+ how you monitored and iterated safely over time

* You keep up with industry developments (model releases, frameworks, best practices) and can translate them into pragmatic improvement

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP), microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience with observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Honeycomb) and AI-specific tooling (e.g., Langfuse, Braintrust, HumanLoop, W&B Weave)

* Competitive compensation and opportunities for rapid advancement

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
MetAntz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting role with one of our customers working in the area of agentic software for digital shelf.
  
  
**Location**
Pune, India or remote
  
  
**About Our Customer**
We build agentic software for the digital shelf. Our customers are large global consumer brands. Our platform decides what their products should say on major online retail sites, writes it, and then measures whether it worked. That includes how products show up when shoppers ask AI assistants what to buy, which is changing faster than most brands can keep up with.
  
  
We are a small, profitable team growing quickly across the US and UK. Every person here owns something real.
  
  
**The role**
This is one role with two halves, and you need to want both.
  
  
**You build.**
You will own one part of the product end to end: design it, ship it, run it in production, and decide what it should become next. Not a ticket queue. A surface of the product with your name on it.
  
  
**You deploy.**
You will be the lead technical contact for one or more customers in the US and UK. You will sit in their working sessions, understand how their teams and catalogs actually work, get our system running on their data, and drive the engagement forward week to week. When something looks wrong on a customer's data, you figure out why.
  
  
The two halves feed each other. What you learn in a customer's account becomes the next thing you build. What you build is what you put in front of the customer.
  
  
You will travel to the US and UK a few times a year to present results to customer stakeholders and join their quarterly reviews: what happened, why, and what we do next. You lead those conversations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own a product area (for example AI shopping assistant visibility, content generation, data ingestion, or performance measurement) from design through production
* Ship working software quickly, with AI coding tools as a core part of how you build
* Lead day-to-day engagement with one or more enterprise customers across US and UK time zones
* Translate messy customer problems into clear technical work, and say plainly when a request is the wrong one
* Diagnose problems on live customer data and fix the root cause, not the symptom
* Present findings to senior customer stakeholders, including results they did not hope for

**What We Are Looking For**

* A strong computer science foundation: data structures, systems, databases, and the ability to reason about a problem before you code it
* 1 to 2 years of real engineering experience where you shipped things people used
* Strong Python and SQL
* Ownership: you finish things without being chased and notice problems nobody assigned to you
* Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain a technical tradeoff to a brand manager in two minutes, in writing or in a room
* Good judgment about what you know and what you do not. You say "I don't know yet" when that is honest, then go find out
* Plus points: exposure to e-commerce or retail (catalogs, marketplaces, search, pricing, product content); comfort with LLMs and agent workflows in production

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* People who want to build only and hand the customer to someone else
* People who want to manage customers only and hand the building to someone else
* Long lists of frameworks and certifications. We care about what you built and why it worked

**Why this role**

* Ownership from your first month: a product area and a customer, not a backlog
* Direct exposure to some of the largest consumer brands in the world, at a stage where most engineers never get in the room
* Work at the edge of AI and commerce, on problems that do not have a playbook yet
* A small team where your judgment shapes the product and the company
* Competitive compensation and chance to work with leadership with global experience

title: Reengineering Sr Analyst C12
description:
AVP, Business Intelligence Sr Analyst - Markets Operations BI (Pune) Citi Market Operations is undergoing a significant, multi-year transformation, implementing a cutting-edge target operating model. We are a dynamic, global organization operating in over 60 countries, covering all post-execution Operations teams including Middle Office, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, and Listed Derivative & Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products, where Citi is consistently a dominant player. This is a large and complex undertaking, focused on risk and controls, regulatory compliance, process re-engineering, automation, people and culture, data transformation, technology investment, and client service. Joining Citi in Pune means being a critical part of this global transformation, shaping the future of Markets Operations. We are passionate about our people and our culture, fostering an exciting environment that encourages diversity of thought and inclusion, and investing significantly in professional development. This role offers unparalleled growth opportunities within a dynamic team, providing global exposure and the chance to make a tangible impact. The Team: Markets Operations Business Intelligence (BI) The Markets Operations Business Intelligence (BI) team is at the forefront of this transformation. We partner with various Operations teams to deliver critical insights into the health of our operational processes. Utilizing a data-driven approach, we identify areas for improvement and ensure that our investments are strategically targeted to achieve maximum efficiency and impact across our global operations. The Opportunity We are seeking an inquisitive and curious Business Intelligence Sr Analyst (AVP level) to join our Markets Operations BI team in Pune. This role offers a unique opportunity to directly influence the future of Citi's Markets Operations by implementing innovative data analytics and dashboarding solutions. You will empower our Operations teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of their processes, identify friction points, mitigate risks, and enhance client service. While strong BI skills are essential, success in this role hinges on a deep, proactive engagement with business processes. We are looking for an individual who is driven to ask critical questions, challenge existing methods, and relentlessly pursue inefficiencies, rather than passively waiting for problems to be presented. Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Market Operations management and technology partners to define and execute the analytics agenda, prioritizing high-value use cases that align with strategic objectives.
* Proactive Problem Identification & Analysis: Beyond assessing known bottlenecks, you will proactively deep-dive into operational processes, using data and insightful questioning (e.g., "why is this done this way?", "what is the purpose of this step?") to identify underlying challenges and systemic inefficiencies. Leverage data to substantiate and support evaluations and recommendations for process health improvements.
* Data-Driven Hypothesis Testing: Conduct in-depth statistical analysis using business data to prove or disprove hypotheses related to process friction, risk exposure, and client behavior.
* Actionable Insights: Produce detailed analyses of complex issues, recommending clear courses of action even when solutions are not immediately evident, and support their implementation.
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement robust data analytics and dashboarding solutions that provide clear, actionable insights into operational performance and efficiency.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong, effective working relationships with Operations stakeholders at all levels, conducting interviews to deeply understand business functions, pain points, and risks from the user’s perspective.
* Program Management: Contribute to the delivery and management of technical data programs across multiple businesses and geographies.
* Change Leadership: Drive change within a collaborative, agile team environment and adapt to unexpected requirement changes and tight deadlines. What You Will Bring: Technical Expertise:
* Advanced SQL: Strong experience with SQL and relational databases for complex data querying and manipulation.
* BI Visualization: Proven experience creating effective and sophisticated dashboards using major BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview).

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Sr. BI Engineer

**Job Description**

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer who can turn complex data into simple and meaningful business insights.
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
You will work closely with business teams, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technology teams to understand business needs and build scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience in Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, and MicroStrategy, along with a good understanding of Databricks and modern data platforms.
  
  
We are also looking for someone who understands how Business Intelligence is evolving, especially how strong semantic models can support AI-assisted and natural-language analytics.
  
  
**Impact of the Role**

* Understand the business meaning behind the data, ask the right questions, and build reporting solutions that business teams can trust and easily use.
* Take ownership, solve complex reporting problems, work directly with business and engineering teams, and help improve the overall BI platform.
* Contribute to how business users will interact with enterprise data in the future as Business Intelligence continues to move toward semantic models, conversational analytics, and AI-assisted reporting.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

* Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric
* MicroStrategy, Intelligent Cubes, REST APIs, SDK-based integrations, and System Manager
* SQL, Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and Delta Lake
* Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Blob Storage, and Azure DevOps
* Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark
* Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies
* AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and natural-language analytics

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
* Build and maintain business semantic models with clear measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and business definitions.
* Develop and maintain MicroStrategy reports, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions.
* Design and work with MicroStrategy schema objects such as attributes, facts, hierarchies, relationships, metrics, filters, prompts, consolidations, and custom groups.
* Work with MicroStrategy projects, Intelligent Cubes, caching, aggregate tables, and VLDB settings to improve reporting performance.
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries across large enterprise datasets.
* Work with Snowflake, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and other enterprise data platforms.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into clear data models, semantic models, reports, and analytical solutions.
* Build solutions using good data modeling practices, including fact and dimension models, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.
* Improve dashboard, SQL, semantic model, and reporting performance.
* Work with business teams to define and maintain consistent business metrics, KPIs, definitions, and calculation logic.
* Understand how AI agents and natural-language analytics can work on top of a governed business semantic layer.
* Add meaningful metadata, descriptions, synonyms, relationships, and business context so AI-based analytics can interpret business questions correctly.
* Work with Data Engineering and AI teams to ensure AI-assisted analytics uses trusted and governed enterprise data.
* Ensure data quality, security, access control, lineage, and consistency across reporting solutions.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide long-term fixes.
* Support deployments and production releases across reporting platforms.
* Review solutions developed by other engineers and help maintain good engineering standards.
* Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge and best practices across the team.
* Take ownership of solutions from requirement understanding through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, and performance optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience with MicroStrategy reporting and dashboard development.
* Good understanding of MicroStrategy schema objects, metrics, filters, prompts, Intelligent Cubes, caching, and performance tuning.
* Strong SQL skills with experience working with large enterprise datasets.
* Good hands-on experience with Snowflake.
* Experience working with Azure Databricks / Delta Lake or similar modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.
* Good understanding of semantic layers, business measures, KPIs, metadata, and relationships.
* Experience with report and query performance optimization.
* Understanding of data quality, governance, security, lineage, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Ability to troubleshoot complex reporting and data issues independently.
* Ability to work directly with business users and translate business questions into technical solutions.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.

description:
**Job Summary**
Contribute as a business analyst with four to five years of experience in the healthcare payer and provider space focusing on benefits open enrollment and HIPAA compliant processes for a hybrid work model in night shifts that supports accurate requirements smooth plan enrollments and compliant data handling for clients and members.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with cross functional healthcare teams to gather business needs for benefits open enrollment and convert them into clear and testable requirement specifications that guide downstream technical work and process design.
* Analyze complex payer and provider workflows related to enrollment eligibility billing and claims to identify gaps inefficiencies and compliance risks that could impact operational accuracy and member satisfaction.
* Document detailed current state and future state process flows for open enrollment scenarios including eligibility updates plan changes and special enrollment events to support consistent execution across business units.
* Develop comprehensive user stories use cases and acceptance criteria that reflect payer and provider rules for benefits enrollment ensuring that every scenario aligns with HIPAA compliant handling of member data.
* Coordinate with product owners configuration specialists and quality analysts to prioritize enrollment related requirements and ensure timely delivery that aligns with night shift release schedules and hybrid collaboration norms.
* Perform deep dive analysis on enrollment files and transactions to resolve data discrepancies such as missing coverage details incorrect effective dates and plan mapping errors that affect payer and provider partners.
* Validate that system configurations benefit plans and enrollment rules support accurate premium calculations coverage periods and member communications across multiple payer and provider lines of business.
* Support user acceptance testing for enrollment and eligibility functions by creating test conditions organizing test data and validating outcomes against business rules and HIPAA guidelines.
* Prepare clear business requirement documents functional specifications and change impact assessments that communicate enrollment impacts to operations technology compliance and client facing teams.
* Engage with stakeholders during night shift meetings to review requirements clarify open questions and align on scope changes while maintaining a professional and inclusive communication style.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to enrollment accuracy turnaround time and rejection rates and propose data driven improvements that enhance service quality for members providers and payer partners.
* Provide subject matter guidance on payer and provider enrollment dependencies to help teams understand how configuration or process changes affect claims adjudication billing and provider network interactions.
* Support incident analysis and root cause investigations for enrollment related production issues by reviewing logs configuration and data to recommend sustainable corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
* Coordinate with compliance and security stakeholders to confirm that enrollment processes data transfers and reports adhere to HIPAA privacy and security requirements while minimizing operational friction.
* Assist in preparing training content and reference guides for operations staff on updated enrollment procedures plan structures and exception handling to promote consistent night shift execution.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts by proposing automation opportunities for enrollment validations reconciliations and notifications that reduce manual effort and error risk across payer and provider operations.

**Qualifications**

* Possess four to five years of focused experience as a business analyst in healthcare domains with substantial exposure to both payer and provider business processes and interactions.
* Demonstrate strong practical expertise in benefits open enrollment including life event processing plan mapping eligibility feeds and reconciliation between payer systems and provider networks.
* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements to design and review processes that safeguard member data during eligibility updates enrollment changes and transmission of enrollment files.
* Utilize solid skills in requirements elicitation process mapping and documentation tools to produce artifacts that are easy for both technical and operations teams to understand and implement.
* Show proficiency in analyzing data using spreadsheets reporting tools or similar applications to validate enrollment outcomes identify trends in error patterns and recommend corrective measures.
* Communicate effectively in spoken and written form with stakeholders across product operations technology and compliance teams while working within a hybrid and night shift environment.
* Adapt to changing client needs and regulatory updates in the healthcare payer and provider landscape while maintaining high quality standards and timely delivery of analysis outcomes.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

 

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

 

**Must Have Qualifications:**

 

* 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity.

* Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing.

* Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability.

* Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods.

* Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath.

* Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase.

 

**Strong Plus:**

 

* UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA).

* Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements.

Our leading payment orchestration platform helps some of the world’s leading brands make payments simpler, smarter and profitable- from improving payment experience and maximizing approval rates, to reducing costs and unlocking new opportunities.

But technology is only part of the story. It’s our people who make the difference.

We’re a global team of innovators, problem-solvers and ambitious professionals who care about the work we do and the impact we have. We work across borders, functions and cultures, bringing different perspectives together to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful results for our customers.

**Your Role:**

We're looking for two experienced Senior Technical Business Analysts to join our Product function, playing a critical role in translating product needs into clear, technically robust requirements for our complex payments platform.

This is an opportunity for experienced payments specialists to make a tangible impact on both our products and how we deliver them. You'll focus on our payment orchestration platform, bringing clarity to complex transaction flows, integrations and business rules so our teams can build with confidence.

These are senior, hands-on roles. You'll have the autonomy to take ownership of complex requirements with minimal supervision, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture and QA.

**Responsibilities:**

* Turn product needs into clear, robust requirements
* Independently elicit, challenge, analyse and refine complex business and technical requirements.
* Identify gaps and ambiguities before development begins.
* Produce clear, comprehensive functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, processing logic, data mappings, exception scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Define requirements across transaction processing, including authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds and routing.

**Understand the platform, its APIs and data**

* Work with API-driven platforms, system integrations, transaction flows and technical dependencies, engaging confidently with Engineers and Architects.
* Interpret API specifications, data models, request/response structures and integration requirements.
* Extract, clean, validate and analyse large datasets.
* Assess end-to-end impacts, identify dependencies, anticipate edge cases and understand how changes affect the wider payments platform.

**Drive requirements through to delivery**

* Work independently across Product, Engineering, Architecture and QA, facilitating technical discussions, challenging assumptions and driving requirements to resolution.
* Support product development through discovery, backlog refinement, development and testing.
* Ensure requirements are understood, validated and ready for delivery.

**Experience:**

We're looking for people who combine deep payments knowledge, strong analytical rigour and the confidence to take ownership of complex problems.

* Proven experience working within a PSP, payment gateway, acquirer or similar payments technology environment.
* Strong knowledge of transaction processing, authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds and routing.
* A strong understanding of API-driven platforms, system integrations, transaction flows and technical dependencies.
* Extensive experience independently eliciting, challenging, analysing and refining complex business and technical requirements.
* The ability to produce clear, comprehensive functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, processing logic, data mappings, exception scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Comfort interpreting API specifications, data models, request/response structures and integration requirements.
* Strong capability to extract, clean, validate and analyse large datasets.
* A systems-thinking approach, with the ability to assess end-to-end impacts, identify dependencies and anticipate edge cases.
* The confidence to work independently across Product, Engineering, Architecture and QA, facilitating technical discussions and challenging assumptions.
* Strong Agile delivery experience across discovery, backlog refinement, development and testing.

**Why Join CellPoint Digital?**

* Work with some of the world's leading travel and airline brands
* Help shape an industry-leading payment orchestration platform
* Join a collaborative, global team with a startup mindset
* High levels of ownership and autonomy
* Opportunity to solve complex, challenging payment problems at scale

If you're passionate about payments, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to make a real impact in a fast-growing global business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Development Engineer I- Fullstack
description:
**About Purplle & Our Mission**
Purplle is more than a beauty e-commerce destination; we are a technology-first platform redefining how digital scale is managed. We are currently in a transformative phase, moving from “manual intervention and firefighting” to an era of Systematic Resilience.
  
  
Our mission is to build “Unbreakable Systems”—platforms that don’t just survive failures but absorb them, self-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop “fixing” and start “architecting” at the highest level.
  
  
THE PURPLLE WAY: AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING
  
  
We Believe That As a Business Scales, Technology Shouldn’t Become More Fragile. We Have Redesigned Our Entire Engineering Lifecycle To Be AI-native, Moving Away From Manual Toil Toward a World Of Intelligent, Self-governing Systems
  
  

* Velocity without Fear (70% AI-Assisted): We ship fast because we’ve built the safety nets to do so. You won’t just be a “coder”; you will be a system architect. We empower our engineers to use AI for the heavy lifting of development—aiming for 70% of Pull Requests to be AI-assisted—so you can focus on complex logic and high-level architecture.
* Built-in Guardrails & Self-Healing Systems: Security and quality aren’t “extra steps”—they are baked into our “Golden Paths.” We build systems that use AI for automated rollbacks and deterministic fallback logic, ensuring the platform absorbs mistakes automatically and remains resilient under pressure.
* Intelligence by Default (Zero-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle—Build,Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate “Ops Toil,” we’ve created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours.
* Predictable Economics & Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the “unit economics” of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business.

THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET & IMPACT
  
  
We Aren’t Looking For “feature Factories”; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform
  
  
The Systems Thinker (Quality & Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You’d rather build a “self-healing” mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of <1.5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev-1 incidents per quarter. The AI-Fluent Architect (High Velocity): You are already using AI tools to 10x your own productivity. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of <4 hours and maintain a high frequency of dailydeployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence.- The Data-Informed Engineer (Economic Discipline): You care about the “why” behind the code. You understand that latency and cloud spend are engineering disciplines, and you optimize your infrastructure so that our cost-per-order remains predictable as we scale.
- The Proactive Collaborator (Security & Governance): You thrive in a cross-functional environment (Eng, Data, DevOps, Security). You take ownership of the “Golden Path,” ensuring 100% of your repositories are gated and that zero critical vulnerabilities ever reach our production environment.
YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be Directly Responsible For**

* AI-Native Velocity: Lead the 70% AI-assisted PR mandate by mastering Cursor, Copilot, and Claude to accelerate delivery of Node.js (NestJS) and Golang microservices—while keeping human intelligence focused on high-level system design and architecture decisions.
* Unbreakable Backend Architecture: Architect high-throughput, event-driven microservices using Kafka and Redis, embedding resilience patterns like circuit breakers, health checks, and fallback mechanisms to handle massive traffic spikes without manual intervention.
* Data & Performance Ownership: Own the ‘unit economics’ of the data layer—optimize MySQL and MongoDB queries, design efficient schemas, and ensure sub-second p99 latencies with predictable infrastructure costs on GCP.
* End-to-End Golden Path Ownership: Drive features from design docs to Kubernetes deployment, ensuring high reliability through strong engineering practices and maintaining low change failure rates and minimal Sev-1 incidents.
* API & Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts.
* Cloud-Native Operations & Observability: Design and operate services on Kubernetes with robust logging, monitoring, and alerting; proactively debug production issues and ensure high availability.
* Scalability & Cost Efficiency: Continuously optimize system throughput, fault tolerance, and infrastructure utilization to support high growth while maintaining strict control over cloud costs.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high-quality outcomes.
* Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

TECH STACK
  
  

* Languages & Frameworks: Node.js (NestJS / Express), Golang
* Data & Messaging: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Aerospike, ElasticSearch
* Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP / AWS, Docker
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
* AI Productivity: Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot

**Experience**

* SDE1 — 1–2 years of backend engineering experience
* SDE2 — 2–5 years; strong ownership of production systems
* SDE3 — 5–7 years; proven track record of designing distributed systems at scale

WHY JOIN PURPLLE TECH?
  
  
You will be joining a team that is actively moving away from the “chaos” of traditional scaling. At Purplle, we are building a tech culture that is “Operational, not Aspirational.”
  
  
We provide the tools, the AI-first environment, and the “Golden Paths” to let you do the best work of your career. If you want to build intelligent, unbreakable systems that scale with confidence, your journey starts here.

title: Senior Software Engineer Full-Stack
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within.
* Implement data visualisations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users.
* Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time.
* Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path.
* Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well.
* Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating.
* Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in.
* Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency.
* Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used.
* Write tests that cover behaviour, including the degraded cases.

**Required Skills**

* 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development.
* Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them.
* Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs.
* Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters.
* Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions.
* Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e.g., RSpec and frontend testing frameworks).
* Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building.
* Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Applicants**
We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  
**Onit Values**
**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
